summary: Mapped the full site (25 core pages + 22 water/rates pages + sitewide cluster map) to .squad/SQ-065/wave1/cartographer-map.md. Trust-surface verdict: author bylines read as transparent desk-credential marks, not fabricated personas NOR established experts — they honestly disclaim credentials but provide no evidence of expertise, and /about never names any of them despite nav listing 5. Sitemap is NOT broken (121 URLs, minified to 1 line). 4 high-value water/gas pages are stranded as orphans.
findings: AUTHORS: all 5 pages (david-chen, margaret-harrington, marcia-washington, roberto-mendoza, tanya-patterson) are deliberately framed as desk-bylines — quoted: 'editorial byline for Utility Explained's ... desk' and 'They are not claims of independently credentialed individuals'. No photos, no credentials, no CVs, 113–242 words each. Verdict: not deceptive personas, but zero demonstrated E-E-A-T. /about never names any of the 5 despite the secondary nav linking '/author/'. Roberto-Mendoza and Tanya-Patterson have no authored article of their own (they reference others' guides).

POLICIES: editorial-policy (9/10) is genuinely strong — it explicitly discloses AI assistance and states 'We do not present AI-generated credentials or fabricated expert qualifications'. methodology (8/10) cites EIA/DOE/tariffs. But they are formulaic boilerplate that claim 'senior' editors without naming one — a skeptical reader sees process claims with no verifiable practitioner.

SITEMAP NOT BROKEN: public/sitemap.xml contains 121 <loc> URLs (verified `grep -o '<loc>' public/sitemap.xml | wc -l` = 121). It's minified to one line, so naive `grep -c '<loc>'` (=1) misleads. hugo.toml [sitemap] + deploy.yml regenerate sitemap.xml on every push. Operator-flagged 'stale 1-URL sitemap' is a false alarm.

ORPHANS (≤2 inbound): 4 high-value stranded pages — water-service-charge-explained (0 metric il, excellent EPA/Louisville/Philly/Cleveland sourcing), drought-surcharge-on-water-bill-explained (1 il), sewer-averaging-water-bill-explained (2 il), mcf-vs-ccf-vs-therms-on-gas-bill (0 metric il). Plus HVAC strings: duct-leaks, ac-running-but-not-cooling, single-stage-vs-two-stage, aux-heat all show 0 metric il.
STRONGEST CORE TRUST ASSET: corrections.md (9/10) has a real, dated correction log (heat-pump DOE 65% fix; Con Ed TOU rate correction) — this is the single most credible page on the site.

CANNIBALIZATION (top): how-to-lower-electric-bill-without-solar (1013w) vs how-to-lower-electric-bill-complete-guide (3593w) — identical target intent, clear merge/redirect case. Also TOU 08 vs 46-what-time-cheapest; heat-pump trio; apartment-budget vs 09-apartment-cost; tiered-electric vs tiered-water; ac-running vs ac-short-cycling.

BROKEN HUB LINKS: electricity-explained links to non-existent /blog/why-your-electric-bill-keeps-rising-2026/ and /blog/15-why-utility-bill-higher-same-usage/; gas-explained links to non-existent /blog/43-understand-natural-gas-bill-charges/ and /blog/why-is-my-gas-bill-so-high-in-summer/ — 4 broken outbound hub links. Only 1 broken target found across all content (/blog/how-to-read-your-utility-bill).
BLOG INDEX LIE: /blog/ claims '97 guides' and per-topic counts (24/16/11/21/14) but there are only 90 blog files — count is stale/aspirational.
